title: Conversion rate: boost it thanks to visuals in 6 practical ways
h1: Conversion rate: boost it thanks to visuals
metaTitle: 6 Essential Practices to Increase Your Conversion Rate with Optimized Visuals
description: Learn how to improve your conversion rate by applying 6 key practices related to using quality visuals. Learn how to optimize your images to attract and convince your potential customers.
author: Laurent Wainberg
content:
In an increasingly competitive e-commerce market, the quality of product visuals plays an essential role in converting visitors into customers. A compelling image not only attracts attention, but also builds trust and encourages buying. Here it is 6 essential practices to optimize your visuals and increase your conversion rate.

‍

‍

1. Multiply the shots for a complete view of the product

‍

‍

Online customers can't touch or try a product, but presenting it from multiple angles makes up for that lack.

  • Vary angles and distances to highlight the details you are looking for.
  • Opt for 360° animations that allow buyers to review the product in all aspects.
  • Detailed views increase confidence and reduce doubts before buying.

According to a study by Shotfarm, an e-merchant can Increase your conversion rate by 35% by offering interactive images such as 360° views.

2. Improve the quality of your images

‍

‍

Blurry or poorly framed images can damage your brand perception and discourage buying.

  • Choose a high resolution for a clean and accurate result.
  • Standardize your shots with automated systems like those of PackshotCreator.
  • Use neutral funds to enhance the product and avoid any distractions.

3. Integrate product videos

‍

‍

Videos are a way to show the product in action and demonstrate its benefits.

  • Product videos are a great way to increase engagement and conversion.
  • 73% of consumers say they are more likely to buy after watching an explanatory video.
  • Orbitvu offers automated solutions to easily capture professionally rendered videos.

4. Use the zoom to highlight details

‍

‍

Zoom allows buyers to examine the finishes, materials, and technical details of the product.

  • A quality zoom reassures and enhances the product.
  • Orbitvu offers a zoom of up to x20 on animations, allowing you to examine even the smallest details.
  • Amazon now allows 360° views and zooming on product sheets.

‍

‍

5. Adopt augmented reality (AR) for total immersion

AR allows customers to visualize a product in their environment before making a purchase.

  • Conversion rates can be up to 4 times higher with AR.
  • 61% of consumers prefer to buy on sites offering this technology.
  • THE ART reduces product returns by an average of 35%, thus improving customer satisfaction.

6. Automate visual production for perfect consistency

Automation makes it possible to produce professional-quality visuals quickly and efficiently.

  • PackshotCreator offers Orbitvu solutions, which standardize the shots while ensuring great speed of execution.
  • Thanks to this equipment, a company was able to capture 4,000 photos and 70 videos in just two days.
  • The adoption of these solutions makes it possible to accelerate the process of creating visuals while guaranteeing consistent quality.

faqs.question: How does automating photography improve productivity?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu solutions significantly reduce shooting and post-production time. Thanks to automation, a product shoot that required several hours can be completed in a few minutes, freeing up time for other high added value tasks.

faqs.question: How does Orbitvu technology boost team creativity?
faqs.answer: By automating the technical aspects of photography, Orbitvu allows marketing and e-commerce teams to focus on staging and optimizing visuals. They can test more angles, vary backgrounds, and experiment with new presentations without time constraints.

faqs.question: Are Orbitvu solutions suitable for businesses of all sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes, whether you are a small business or a large retailer, Orbitvu offers solutions adapted to different production volumes and budgets. The aim is to make product photography accessible and effective for everyone.

faqs.question: How to easily integrate these automated visuals on e-commerce platforms?
faqs.answer: The files generated by Orbitvu are directly compatible with most e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon, etc.), facilitating their integration and putting them online.

faqs.question: How do CSV files facilitate the import of product visuals?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu solutions allow visual data to be exported in the form of CSV files, thus facilitating their integration into e-commerce platforms. The bulk import of visuals is simplified thanks to CSV files, allowing hundreds of photos and videos to be automatically uploaded to an e-commerce site without manual intervention. Each visual is linked to a SKU (product reference) to be instantly attributed to the right product sheet. Updating catalogs becomes fast and efficient, as e-retailers can change their visuals or add new products in a single click by updating their CSV file.
